abstract_support_rank.boundary_cases: For r=0 use the empty determinant equal to one and C=I_n; for r=n the forced unit exponent is zero.
abstract_support_rank.construction: For A=-I_n+P Q, B=-I_n+R S, C=BA, let Y=[Q;S], choose a full-row basis T0 with Y=L T0, put U=[R S P-P,-R] and X=U L, so C=I_n+X T0.
abstract_support_rank.factorization: chi_C(t)=(t-1)^(n-r) det((t-1)I_r-T0 X), where r=rank([Q;S]) and the reduced determinant is monic of degree r.
abstract_support_rank.scope: Only algebraic and geometric unit multiplicity at least n-r and nonunit characteristic degree at most r; the reduced determinant may contain further t-1 factors.

arithmetic_and_spectrum.finite_field_check: The prime-divisor and quotient conditions hold because ord(c)=p-1 and d|(p-1); if 4|d then p=1 mod 4, and d=2 is separately checked by c being a nonsquare.
arithmetic_and_spectrum.modular_reduction: The lifted residue multiset is the root set of x^d-1, so intermediate elementary symmetric functions vanish modulo p and chi_C(t)=t^d-c modulo p.
arithmetic_and_spectrum.perron_degree: C is strictly positive; Perron-Frobenius and exact degree visibility give lambda_1(F)=rho(C), and irreducibility makes rho(C) a Perron algebraic integer of degree exactly d.
arithmetic_and_spectrum.rational_irreducibility: The exact finite-field binomial criterion makes t^d-c irreducible over F_p; monicity and Gauss's lemma make chi_C irreducible over Q.

construction.field_and_degree: Characteristic-zero base field and ordinary total degree.
construction.maps: S_V(q,p)=(q,p+grad V(q)), T_W(q,p)=(q+grad W(p),p), F=T_W composed with S_V; symmetric Hessians prove symplecticity and subtraction gives polynomial inverses.
construction.parameter_order: For every d>=2 choose d -> a prime p=1 mod d and generator c -> ordered positive lifts a_1<...<a_d of all d-th roots of unity with a_1+1>4d -> b in bd=1-(-1)^d c mod p and R=1+2a_d/(b sum a_i), with b>=2, R^2<2, and b(a_i-a_1)sum a_j>a_i^2 R-a_1^2 for i>1.
construction.potentials: V(q)=prod_j q_j^2+sum_i q_i^(a_i+1) and W(p)=prod_j p_j^b, with exactly these positive integer coefficients and supports.
construction.selected_matrices: D=diag(a_i), B=bJ-I_d, C=BD=b*1*a^T-D; C_ii=(b-1)a_i>0 and C_ij=b a_j>0 for i!=j.

exact_degree.broad_cone: K_ratio(R)={u>0:max u_i<=R min u_i}; it contains 1, strictly selects every pure spike over the mixed V row, maps strictly into its interior under C, and supports the cross-block estimate.
exact_degree.carries: At the first V phase a_i>1 beats degree-one momentum; later D u_n>D u_(n-1). At each W phase (C u)_i>max_j a_j u_j>u_i, so every fresh coordinate beats every carried p and q coordinate.
exact_degree.fine_chamber: K_vis(R)={u>0:u_i<=u_1<R u_i and a_1 u_1<a_i u_i for i>1}; the seed lies on only the permitted equality walls, C preserves all strict walls, and coordinate 1 becomes strictly largest.
exact_degree.no_cancellation: All coordinate polynomials remain in the nonnegative integer coefficient semiring; strict top-degree sources, the integral-domain top-form rule, and characteristic zero prevent cancellation.
exact_degree.visible_identity: With u_n=C^n 1, deg(F^n)=e_1^T C^n 1 for every n>=0; q_1 is the unique degree-maximal coordinate for n>=1, while all coordinates tie at n=0.

scalar_recurrence.eventual_order: The positive Perron asymptotic coefficient excludes every rational constant-coefficient tail recurrence of order below d.
scalar_recurrence.exact_order: For s_n=e_1^T C^n 1, Cayley-Hamilton gives order at most d; irreducibility makes every nonzero state and covector cyclic, so reachability and observability matrices are invertible and the d-by-d Hankel matrix has rank d.
scalar_recurrence.scope: The minimal rational constant-coefficient recurrence order is exactly d both from n=0 and eventually.

sharpness.presentation: D=-I_d+I_d(D+I_d) and bJ-I_d=-I_d+(b*1)1^T; D+I_d is invertible, so the stacked selected row rank is r=d.
sharpness.result: For every constructed d>=2, irreducibility excludes t-1 and the full nonunit characteristic degree d attains the support-rank bound; this is existential sharpness only.
